subject: Finovar: intermittent e2e failures to private model endpoints — path validation
messages:
From: NetOps Team <netops@finovar.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intermittent timeouts to private model endpoints (Finovar-prod)

Hi Soojin,

We're seeing intermittent connection failures from our on-prem application tier to the Redwood private deployment (finovar-prod). Symptoms: TCP connections establish but stall during TLS handshake (~60s timeouts) or we see ECONNRESET. Issue started ~2026-08-19 22:00 PDT and recurs every 10-30 minutes.

What we've observed so far:
- traceroute from on-prem appliance to 10.64.23.45 (model endpoint) shows last hop within our CPE then nothing (no ICMP replies).
- tcpdump captures show SYN retransmits and then RSTs originating from the AWS transit side.
- Our IPSec tunnel shows up and the SA is up; no obvious issues.
